scenarios.prompt: A QA session changes progression state and force-selects a phase before recording a feature clip. Record session/build/save provenance and linked capture ID as structured data.

criteria.provenance: Stable session ID links build, save/profile provenance and QA/debug state changes.
criteria.structure: Evidence survives cropping/restart because provenance is structured, not only visual.
criteria.scope: Modified-state evidence cannot silently become natural progression/challenge proof.
